why: The major names here (Kiplinger, Tom's Guide, Cyclingnews, TechRadar) cover other topics: Christmas lights, storm prep, bike lights and radios. No major reviewer or authority tests AA batteries in solar lights. The pages that do answer are affiliate listicles built on Amazon widgets, an Indian solar installer's general guide, and one niche page that names a capacity range but no products. A focused page that compares named cells with run-time data and current prices would stand out.
